verdict.rationale: Docs confirm programmatic wallet creation per customer/account (docs-4, docs-25) and deposit-address provisioning via 'channels' (docs-10, docs-26) plus virtual accounts (docs-12), covering the core per-customer wallet/address story. However, there is no documented explanation of key custody semantics (who controls private keys, custodial vs. non-custodial model) anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit key custody/ownership documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of wallet provisioning behavior.
